Tibetans and Uyghurs protest Xi Jinping's US visit in Washington

Tibetans and Uyghurs held anti-China protests in Washington during Xi Jinping's visit to the US. The protests, which took place in Washington, voiced demands for China to leave Tibet. Coverage included photographic elements of the demonstrations.
